heroText: Motegi works best as a base in Japan when you anchor days around Mobility Resort Motegi, Honda Collection Hall and Twin Ring Motegi Road Course. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Ibaraki Airport (IBR) handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.

history.text: Mike Skinner won the only NASCAR Winston Cup Series exhibition race held at the track in 1998, the Coca-Cola 500.
The track also hosted the NASCAR Winston West Series finale in 1999, with Kevin Richards getting the win.
In Honda's 2005 Clio Awards winning commercial "Impossible Dream", the sequence in which the BAR Formula One car is driven into the bridge was filmed at the circuit.

In 2011, Casey Stoner and Jorge Lorenzo proposed to boycott the MotoGP race out of fears for their health from radiation from the Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant even though all the independent scientific experts including the World Health Organization and Australian Radiation Protection and Nuclear Safety Agency had stated that it is safe to live permanently 80 km (50 mi) or more from the plant.
